mechanics.claim: If Pierce kills the target, the spear continues onward and can hit an additional enemy, transferring the killed target's Rend stacks.
mechanics.quote: If ''Pierce'' kills the target, the spear continues onward to transfer all of the target's ''{{ai|Rend|Kalista}}'' stacks to the next enemy it hits.

mechanics.claim: Pierce is a single-target physical damage spear that can be blocked by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: launches a spear in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit
